texts.NIV84: The wicked man flees though no one pursues, but the righteous are as bold as a lion.
texts.KJV: The wicked flee when no man pursueth: but the righteous are bold as a lion.
texts.NKJV:
The wicked flee when no one pursues,
But the righteous are bold as a lion.
texts.DRB: The wicked man fleeth, when no man pursueth: but the just, bold as a lion, shall be without dread.

texts.NIV84: When a country is rebellious, it has many rulers, but a man of understanding and knowledge maintains order.
texts.KJV: For the transgression of a land many are the princes thereof: but by a man of understanding and knowledge the state thereof shall be prolonged.
texts.DRB: For the sine of the land many are the princes thereof: and for the wisdom of a man, and the knowledge of those things that are said, the life of the prince shall be prolonged.

texts.NIV84: A ruler who oppresses the poor is like a driving rain that leaves no crops.
texts.KJV: A poor man that oppresseth the poor is like a sweeping rain which leaveth no food.
texts.NKJV:
A poor man who oppresses the poor
Is like a driving rain which leaves no food.
texts.DRB: A poor man that oppresseth the poor, is like a violent shower, which bringeth a famine.

texts.NIV84: Those who forsake the law praise the wicked, but those who keep the law resist them.
texts.KJV: They that forsake the law praise the wicked: but such as keep the law contend with them.
texts.NKJV:
Those who forsake the law praise the wicked,
But such as keep the law contend with them.
texts.DRB: They that forsake the law, praise the wicked man: they that keep it, are incensed against him.

texts.NIV84: Evil men do not understand justice, but those who seek the LORD understand it fully.
texts.KJV: Evil men understand not judgment: but they that seek the Lord understand all things.
texts.NKJV:
Evil men do not understand justice,
But those who seek the Lord understand all.
texts.DRB: Evil men think not on judgment: but they that seek after the Lord, take notice of all things.

texts.NIV84: Better a poor man whose walk is blameless than a rich man whose ways are perverse.
texts.KJV: Better is the poor that walketh in his uprightness, than he that is perverse in his ways, though he be rich.
texts.NKJV:
Better is the poor who walks in his integrity
Than one perverse in his ways, though he be rich.
texts.DRB: Better is the poor man walking in his simplicity, than the rich in crooked ways.

blocks.title: Who Turns His Ear from Hearing the Law

texts.NIV84: He who keeps the law is a discerning son, but a companion of gluttons disgraces his father.
texts.KJV: Whoso keepeth the law is a wise son: but he that is a companion of riotous men shameth his father.
texts.NKJV:
Whoever keeps the law is a discerning son,
But a companion of gluttons shames his father.
texts.DRB: He that keepeth the law is a wise son: but he that feedeth gluttons, shameth his father.

texts.NIV84: He who increases his wealth by exorbitant interest amasses it for another, who will be kind to the poor.
texts.KJV: He that by usury and unjust gain increaseth his substance, he shall gather it for him that will pity the poor.
texts.NKJV:
One who increases his possessions by usury and extortion
Gathers it for him who will pity the poor.
texts.DRB: He that heapeth together riches by usury and loan, gathereth them for him that will be bountiful to the poor.

texts.NIV84: If anyone turns a deaf ear to the law, even his prayers are detestable.
texts.KJV: He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer shall be abomination.
texts.NKJV:
One who turns away his ear from hearing the law,
Even his prayer is an abomination.
texts.DRB: He that turneth away his ears from hearing the law, his prayer shall be as abomination.

texts.NIV84: He who leads the upright along an evil path will fall into his own trap, but the blameless will receive a good inheritance.
texts.KJV: Whoso causeth the righteous to go astray in an evil way, he shall fall himself into his own pit: but the upright shall have good things in possession.
texts.DRB: He that deceiveth the just in a wicked way, shall fall in his own destruction: and the upright shall possess his goods.

blocks.title: A Happy Man is Always Reverent

texts.NIV84: A rich man may be wise in his own eyes, but a poor man who has discernment sees through him.
texts.KJV: The rich man is wise in his own conceit; but the poor that hath understanding searcheth him out.
texts.NKJV:
The rich man is wise in his own eyes,
But the poor who has understanding searches him out.
texts.DRB: The rich man seemeth to himself wise: but the poor man that is prudent shall search him out.

texts.NIV84: When the righteous triumph, there is great elation; but when the wicked rise to power, men go into hiding.
texts.KJV: When righteous men do rejoice, there is great glory: but when the wicked rise, a man is hidden.
texts.NKJV:
When the righteous rejoice, there is great glory;
But when the wicked arise, men hide themselves.
texts.DRB: In the joy of the just there is great glory: when the wicked reign, men are ruined.

texts.NIV84: He who conceals his sins does not prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.
texts.KJV: He that covereth his sins shall not prosper: but whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall have mercy.
texts.NKJV:
He who covers his sins will not prosper,
But whoever confesses and forsakes them will have mercy.
texts.DRB: He that hideth his sins, shall not prosper: but he that shall confess, and forsake them, shall obtain mercy.

texts.NIV84: Blessed is the man who always fears the LORD, but he who hardens his heart falls into trouble.
texts.KJV: Happy is the man that feareth alway: but he that hardeneth his heart shall fall into mischief.
texts.NKJV:
Happy is the man who is always reverent,
But he who hardens his heart will fall into calamity.
texts.DRB: Blessed is the man that is always fearful: but he that is hardened in mind, shall fall into evil.

blocks.title: He Who Walks Blamelessly Will Be Saved

texts.NIV84: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked man ruling over a helpless people.
texts.KJV: As a roaring lion, and a ranging bear; so is a wicked ruler over the poor people.
texts.NKJV:
Like a roaring lion and a charging bear
Is a wicked ruler over poor people.
texts.DRB: As a roaring lion, and a hungry bear, so is a wicked prince over the poor people.

texts.NIV84: A tyrannical ruler lacks judgment, but he who hates ill-gotten gain will enjoy a long life.
texts.KJV: The prince that wanteth understanding is also a great oppressor: but he that hateth covetousness shall prolong his days.
texts.NKJV:
A ruler who lacks understanding is a great oppressor,
But he who hates covetousness will prolong his days.
texts.DRB: A prince void of prudence shall oppress many by calumny: but he that hateth covetousness, shall prolong his days.

texts.NIV84: A man tormented by the guilt of murder will be a fugitive till death; let no one support him.
texts.KJV: A man that doeth violence to the blood of any person shall flee to the pit; let no man stay him.
texts.NKJV:
A man burdened with bloodshed will flee into a pit;
Let no one help him.
texts.DRB: A man that doth violence to the blood of a person, if he flee even to the pit, no man will stay him.

texts.NIV84: He whose walk is blameless is kept safe, but he whose ways are perverse will suddenly fall.
texts.KJV: Whoso walketh uprightly shall be saved: but he that is perverse in his ways shall fall at once.
texts.NKJV:
Whoever walks blamelessly will be saved,
But he who is perverse in his ways will suddenly fall.
texts.DRB: He that walketh uprightly, shall be saved: he that is perverse in his ways shall fall at once.

blocks.title: A Man With an Evil Eye

texts.NIV84: He who works his land will have abundant food, but the one who chases fantasies will have his fill of poverty.
texts.KJV: He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread: but he that followeth after vain persons shall have poverty enough.
texts.NKJV:
He who tills his land will have plenty of bread,
But he who follows frivolity will have poverty enough!
texts.DRB: He that tilleth his ground, shall be filled with bread: but he that followeth idleness shall be filled with poverty.

texts.NIV84: A faithful man will be richly blessed, but one eager to get rich will not go unpunished.
texts.KJV: A faithful man shall abound with blessings: but he that maketh haste to be rich shall not be innocent.
texts.NKJV:
A faithful man will abound with blessings,
But he who hastens to be rich will not go unpunished.
texts.DRB: A faithful man shall be much praised: but he that maketh haste to be rich, shall not be innocent.

texts.NIV84: To show partiality is not good- yet a man will do wrong for a piece of bread.
texts.KJV: To have respect of persons is not good: for for a piece of bread that man will transgress.
texts.NKJV:
To show partiality is not good,
Because for a piece of bread a man will transgress.
texts.DRB: He that hath respect to a person in judgment, doth not well: such a man even for a morsel of bread forsaketh the truth.

texts.NIV84: A stingy man is eager to get rich and is unaware that poverty awaits him.
texts.KJV: He that hasteth to be rich hath an evil eye, and considereth not that poverty shall come upon him.
texts.NKJV:
A man with an evil eye hastens after riches,
And does not consider that poverty will come upon him.
texts.DRB: A man, that maketh haste to be rich, and envieth others, is ignorant that poverty shall come upon him.

texts.NIV84: He who rebukes a man will in the end gain more favor than he who has a flattering tongue.
texts.KJV: He that rebuketh a man afterwards shall find more favour than he that flattereth with the tongue.
texts.NKJV:
He who rebukes a man will find more favor afterward
Than he who flatters with the tongue.
texts.DRB: He that rebuketh a man, shall afterward find favour with him, more than he that by a flattering tongue deceiveth him.

blocks.title: Whoever Walks Wisely Will Be Delivered

texts.NIV84: He who robs his father or mother and says, "It's not wrong"- he is partner to him who destroys.
texts.KJV: Whoso robbeth his father or his mother, and saith, It is no transgression; the same is the companion of a destroyer.
texts.NKJV:
Whoever robs his father or his mother,
And says, “It is no transgression,”
The same is companion to a destroyer.
texts.DRB: He that stealeth any thing from his father, or from his mother: and saith, This is no sin, is the partner of a murderer.

texts.NIV84: A greedy man stirs up dissension, but he who trusts in the LORD will prosper.
texts.KJV: He that is of a proud heart stirreth up strife: but he that putteth his trust in the Lord shall be made fat.
texts.NKJV:
He who is of a proud heart stirs up strife,
But he who trusts in the Lord will be prospered.
texts.DRB: He that boasteth, and puffeth up himself, stirreth up quarrels: but he that trusteth in the Lord, shall be healed.

texts.NIV84: He who trusts in himself is a fool, but he who walks in wisdom is kept safe.
texts.KJV: He that trusteth in his own heart is a fool: but whoso walketh wisely, he shall be delivered.
texts.NKJV:
He who trusts in his own heart is a fool,
But whoever walks wisely will be delivered.
texts.DRB: He that trusteth in his own heart, is a fool: but he that walketh wisely, he shall be saved.

texts.NIV84: He who gives to the poor will lack nothing, but he who closes his eyes to them receives many curses.
texts.KJV: He that giveth unto the poor shall not lack: but he that hideth his eyes shall have many a curse.
texts.NKJV:
He who gives to the poor will not lack,
But he who hides his eyes will have many curses.
texts.DRB: He that giveth to the poor, shall not want: he that despiseth his entreaty, shall suffer indigence.

texts.NIV84: When the wicked rise to power, people go into hiding; but when the wicked perish, the righteous thrive.
texts.KJV: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves: but when they perish, the righteous increase.
texts.NKJV:
When the wicked arise, men hide themselves;
But when they perish, the righteous increase.
texts.DRB: When the wicked rise up, men shall hide themselves: when they perish, the just shall be multiplied.
